from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """One expense line item extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as found in the filing")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label for the expense (e.g. 'Selling, general and administrative')")
    amount_str: str | None = Field(description="The numeric amount as written in the document (e.g. '5,939' or '28,371')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
